memory_update.text: PDFS should be tracked as a high-priority underfollowed candidate for semiconductor fab automation/data analytics within the physical AI buildout theme; key verification is organic analytics growth and customer evidence tied to advanced packaging, HBM, and high-volume fabs.

ITRI should be tracked as a grid-edge software/DERMS second-order beneficiary of data-center load and grid modernization; key verification is software/services mix, ARR, DERMS deployments, and utility references.

Need a later pass focused specifically on semiconductor MES/fab automation and equipment-control software vendors; many pure plays may be private, acquired, foreign-listed, or hidden inside larger automation groups.

node: Automation and industrial software embedded in semiconductor fabs, data centers, utilities, and regulated manufacturing
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the automation/industrial-software node found one highly relevant semiconductor-fab software candidate, two grid/infrastructure software candidates, and one construction-workflow automation candidate. The strongest underfollowed fit is PDF Solutions because its Exensio, Cimetrix, and secureWISE assets sit directly in semiconductor manufacturing analytics, equipment connectivity, and fab/fabless/OSAT data collaboration. Itron is a second-order grid-modernization software and edge-intelligence candidate tied to utility capacity constraints created by electrification and AI data-center load. Bentley Systems is a larger reference/near-reference infrastructure engineering software name with digital twins and asset analytics exposure. Procore is included as a speculative shadow candidate for data-center and infrastructure construction execution software, but direct AI/data-center exposure requires verification.
